o1.biggest_strength: Ties every email to the two retention habits, branches on platform, and adds a control group and guardrail so we can actually prove it worked.
o1.biggest_mistake: Email 5's branching is a bit tangled (recurring vs one-device vs neither) and the 'bolder move' at the end adds a half-formed idea that isn't in the plan.
o1.what_would_make_it_a_10: Cleaner, simpler branches for email 5 and drop the trailing experiment so the whole thing reads as one finished plan.

o2.biggest_strength: Natural, calm copy with good typed examples and a sensible Pro email gated to engaged users.
o2.biggest_mistake: Uses the old series as its holdout instead of a true control, and its unsubscribe guardrail (0.4%) is stricter than the old day-1 benchmark without saying why.
o2.what_would_make_it_a_10: Compare against a no-email control group, not just the old series, and make the recurring/second-device path one clear story rather than three habits.

reason: Both are usable and on-brief, but Output 1's plan is easier to act on this week: it names the two habits, skips emails people don't need, and measures against a control group.
